shortDescription: Manage cluster discovery configurations in PX-Backup

options.name: config_type
options.description: Type of discovery configuration Currently only Shoot (Gardener) is supported

options.name: confirm_update
options.description: Confirmation flag required for update operations Must be set to true explicitly; otherwise the update will be rejected

options.name: gardener_kubeconfig
options.description: Base64-encoded Gardener API server kubeconfig to rotate or replace existing credentials Only used with the UPDATE operation to update the kubeconfig of an existing discovery configuration

options.name: include_secrets
options.description: Include sensitive fields like kubeconfigs in the response

options.name: labels
options.description: Labels to attach to the cluster discovery configuration

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the cluster discovery configuration Required for all operations except INSPECT_ALL

options.name: operation
options.description: Operation to perform on the cluster discovery config - CREATE: creates a new cluster discovery configuration - UPDATE: modifies an existing cluster discovery configuration - DELETE: removes a cluster discovery configuration - INSPECT_ONE: retrieves details of a specific configuration - INSPECT_ALL: lists all cluster discovery configurations - DISCOVER_CLUSTERS: manually triggers cluster discovery - REFRESH_CLUSTERS: manually triggers credential refresh for discovered clusters

options.name: settings
options.description: Common discovery settings (polling frequency, auto-discover toggle)

options.name: shoot_config
options.description: Gardener Shoot discovery configuration Required when config_type is Shoot during CREATE

options.name: ssl_config
options.description: SSL configuration dictionary containing certificate settings Contains validate_certs, ca_cert, client_cert, and client_key options

options.name: uid
options.description: Unique identifier of the cluster discovery configuration Optional but recommended for exact match in update/delete/discover/refresh
